Coram : R.F. NARIMAN*, M.R. SHAH
High Courts – Power to recall its order – Appellant issued Tender Notice for supply, installation and maintenance of water meters – Tender Notice was accepted and parties entered into an agreement, which included a clause (cl.13 of the General Conditions of Contract) stating was allowed” – Respondent filed an application u/s. 9 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 seeking interim injunction, which was allowed – Thereafter on the next date of hearing, a sole Arbitrator was appointed with the consent of both the parties – Recall
Decision Date : 04-12-2018 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 11822/2018 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
